items.source: A ReadWriteLock maintains a pair of associated locks, one for read-only operations and one for writing. The read lock may be held simultaneously by multiple reader threads, so long as there are no writers. The write lock is exclusive.
items.translation: `ReadWriteLock` 维护一对关联的locks，一个用于只读操作，另一个用于写入。多个读者线程可以同时持有读锁，只要没有写线程存在。写锁是独占的。
